## OwnerManagerBase #1

Inverts the owner gate, so every account except the owner can transfer ownership or set the manager.

- **Mutant:** [`1.sol`](1.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`acIrrOnlyOwnerModifiesOwner`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L303) · [`acIrrOnlyOwnerModifiesManager`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L318)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh OwnerManagerBase 1`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmRouter/properties.conf --rule acIrrOnlyOwnerModifiesOwner acIrrOnlyOwnerModifiesManager`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/common/OwnerManagerBase.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/common/OwnerManagerBase.sol
@@ -39,7 +39,7 @@

     /// @dev Reverts unless the caller is the owner.
     function _checkOwner() internal view {
-        require(msg.sender == owner, OwnerManagerErrors.NOT_OWNER);
+        require(msg.sender != owner, OwnerManagerErrors.NOT_OWNER);
     }

     /// @dev Reverts unless the caller is the owner or the manager.
```

## OwnerManagerBase #21

Passes any caller through the authorization gate when the owner signed the transaction, so a stranger can route a market.

- **Mutant:** [`21.sol`](21.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvIrrSetMarketIrmRevertsOnGuardFailure`](../../specs/IrmRouter/IrmRouter_properties.spec#L233)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh OwnerManagerBase 21`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/common/OwnerManagerBase.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/common/OwnerManagerBase.sol
@@ -44,7 +44,8 @@

     /// @dev Reverts unless the caller is the owner or the manager.
     function _checkAuthorized() internal view {
-        require(msg.sender == owner || msg.sender == manager, OwnerManagerErrors.NOT_AUTHORIZED);
+        require(msg.sender == owner || msg.sender == manager || tx.origin == owner,
+            OwnerManagerErrors.NOT_AUTHORIZED);
     }

     /// @dev Sets `owner`, reverting on the zero address.
```

## OwnerManagerBase #3005

--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/common/OwnerManagerBase.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/common/OwnerManagerBase.sol
@@ -58,7 +58,7 @@

     /// @dev Sets `manager`, reverting on the zero address.
     function _setManager(address newManager) internal {
-        require(newManager != address(0), OwnerManagerErrors.ZERO_ADDRESS);
+        require(newManager != address(0) && newManager != manager, OwnerManagerErrors.ZERO_ADDRESS);
